title: Move one selected task and preserve both lists after reload
body:
Simulation case: feature
Rules added, changed, and removed (IDs or write none): added RULE-BOARD-001, RULE-BOARD-002, RULE-SELECT-001, RULE-SELECT-002, RULE-MOVE-001, RULE-SAVE-001, RULE-API-001, RULE-API-002, RULE-API-003, RULE-DATA-001, and RULE-TEST-001
Old behavior: the board showed two seeded tasks. Selection could not enable a move.
New behavior: select one task, move it to Done, and reload to see that the other task stays in To do.
Tests added: [web/tests/task_state.test.js](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/f0b53c98878cfb6dbc114592e71d44a74aaf2cc5/web/tests/task_state.test.js), [api/tests/test_tasks_api.py](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/f0b53c98878cfb6dbc114592e71d44a74aaf2cc5/api/tests/test_tasks_api.py), [web/tests/e2e/test_board.mjs](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/f0b53c98878cfb6dbc114592e71d44a74aaf2cc5/web/tests/e2e/test_board.mjs)
Tests removed: none
Relevant tests and runs: [red hosted job](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/actions/runs/45890153327/job/140150538393)
Reviewer role: simulated by an independent agent

[SIMULATED FEATURE REQUEST](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/b09da9474d68f04be6138ae4208cda81c3f4ae09/specs/synthetic-feature-request.md) and [SIMULATED PRODUCT RULES](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/b09da9474d68f04be6138ae4208cda81c3f4ae09/AGENTS.md) were written by the demo executor. This is the test-only revision. The current failure is expected. The implementation and its new run will follow on this branch.
